The '''''Cryptic Warning''''' was one of the two [[EE-104 Fisheye]]s that were stolen by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] for use for their [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. It was commanded by [[Sith Saber]] [[Querdan Dei]] and was used during the [[Jedi Queen project]].

==Characteristics==
It, like most of the Fisheyes made in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] had no windows. This was to stop light from being picked up by enemy sensors. It also had a hull that was designed to mimic the environment around it. Another way that it was designed for stealth was its general oval shape, so it could keep a low profile. It also had a special stealth coating that would cause scans to bounce back to the ship sending them.
